metadata.value: To give context to the model performance, we compare the performance with human workers. For each comment, we randomly hold out one annotator to act as our 'human model' and use the aggregated score of the other annotators as the ground truth to compute the ROC AUC (repeated 5 times then averaged). We use the same test sets to compute the ROC AUC of the trained BERT model and average those scores as well.
